messages.subject: Cannot use Rhipe >> AccessControlException: Permission denied
messages.subject_clean: Cannot use Rhipe >> AccessControlException: Permission denied
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

it is a few days I am stuck with the installation of Rhipe in ubuntu. I hope you can give me some advice:

My configuration is:
- ubuntu 14.04
- java version 1.8.0_25
- hadoop-1.2.1
- protobuf-2.4.1
- R-3.0.0
- Rhipe_0.73.1

I install java, hadoop, R, protobuf, and rJava and Rhipe packages in sequence. I set the environmental variables. The end of my bashrc file looks this way:

export HADOOP=/usr/local/hadoop
export HADOOP_HOME=/usr/local/hadoop
export HADOOP_BIN=/usr/local/hadoop/bin
export HADOOP_CONF_DIR=/usr/local/hadoop/conf
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/lib/pkconfig
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/R-3.0.0/src/main/:/usr/local/lib
export R_LIBS=$HOME/R_LIBS

I run R, call library(Rhipe) and call rhinit(). The result looks good to me:

> rhinit()
Rhipe: Using Rhipe.jar file
Initializing Rhipe v0.73
Initializing mapfile caches
>

The problem comes in calling the function rhwrite. I get the following:

> rhwrite(irisSplit, 'irisData')
Error in .jnew("org/godhuli/rhipe/RHWriter", as.character(file), as.integer(numperfile),  :
  org.apache.hadoop.security.AccessControlException: org.apache.hadoop.security.AccessControlException: Permission denied: user=edo, access=WRITE, inode="":hduser:supergroup:rwxr-xr-x

Can anyone help me fixing this. I would really appreciate.
Thanks a lot

best,

Edoardo

messages.subject_clean: Cannot use Rhipe >> AccessControlException: Permission denied
messages.body_plain:
As I do not know how to create read/write permissions on the HDFS for the edo user (I am an hadoop and ubuntu newbie), I solved by inserting the following property into the conf/hdfs-site.xml file:
 <property>
    <name>dfs.permissions</name>
    <value>false</value>
  </property>
Now it seems to work. Thank you for your reply. It was very useful.

Edoardo

Hello,

I've successfully build Rhipe and install it on nodes using HDP stack. There are a few commands that works ok (rhls, rhread, rhwrite...) but I can't run a MR job with a response similar to this unresolved thread https://groups.google.com/d/msg/rhipe/mCxSIcYWxNI/oEDL99KNo1EJ

The example job I run to get the same ouput as in mentioned thread is

map <- function(a,b)
   for(i in 1:1000)
    rhcollect(runif(1),1)
m <- rhwatch(map=map, reduce=0, input=c(1000,3),read=FALSE)

m <- rhwatch(map=map, input=rhfmt('/tmp/x',type='text'),read=FALSE)
